title: Pay actual row mass and the supplied tail without claiming it was measured
statement: The separately received weighted-row source uses the same physical purification at every encoder. Selected true leading directions and a supplied balanced anchor give a root approximation with tail tau_row, while bad-shaped and rare rows are paid by actual mass. Its Bell-risk oracle inequality adds 2^14 tau_row/(kappa gamma); that tail is not certified by this theorem or imported by the residual-validation route.

requires: Stationary/reset physical source, known k-dimensional receiver basis and fixed four-real-coordinate isometric encoder family
A supplied anchor balanced against selected true leading row directions and the physical compatible lift
provides: A separate approximation-sensitive task bound preserving arbitrary full coherent decoder comparison
assumptions: No minimum row mass or exact-rank certification
Tail bounds can be vacuous and remain acquisition inputs
This oracle theorem is neither required by nor equivalent to actual learned-residual validation
costs: Generic deterministic cap O_tilde(k^4/(gamma epsilon)); well-balanced exact-row high-probability actual bill O_tilde((d+dr)/(kappa_* gamma epsilon))
Paid collective quantum bank, classical rational anchor search, up to 3d learned kernel settings per stage, one actual accepted anchor bank and fresh fallback calls
contract.units: Bell loss/global Bell-test failure and averaged half-diamond or permitted strategy distance only where the source supplies that conversion. Block calls, total qubit traffic, bits, controls, routing and memory are separate.
contract.obstruction: Replacing actual anchor weights by leading-row weights silently drops unmodeled source mass.

evidence.quote: # Weighted near-rank-one row tails: an explicit task penalty
evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: This is not a generic k^2 deterministic cap, unknown-basis acquisition or a retained-source-memory theorem. A random output frame need not preserve actual row geometry. Resource-event probabilities require the separately bound predecision record-retaining implementation debit inside the whole-process budget. A supplied-tail oracle extension is separate from actual residual validation and does not acquire its tail for free. No end-to-end quantum bank/production optimizer/hardware run or practical advantage is established. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Acquired completed independent main/statistics review at the exact source version pinned in its receipt. Pending source headers are historical; actual conditional internal acceptance is sufficient. This insertion performs source correspondence and retrieval checks only.
